about_short_description.short_description: BeWell Digital is a provider of a digital platform to help hospitals go paperless with digitization.

product.name: BeWell Digital Teleradiology System
product.description: A cloud-based platform enabling radiologists to view, analyze, and report medical images remotely with integrated AI support and administrative tools.

product.name: BeWell PACS System
product.description: A web-based Picture Archiving and Communication System (PACS) for storing, viewing, and sharing high-quality radiology images digitally across multiple users and devices.

product.name: Radiology Information System (RIS) Integration
product.description: Software integrated with PACS to manage patient records, appointments, and radiology workflows, improving report turnaround and administrative efficiency.

product.name: BeWell Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application providing radiologists and clinicians access to high-quality patient images, reports, and notifications on Android and iOS devices.
